name: Muro Horizontal — HP 3/3 Intacto
generation_strategy: IMAGEN INDIVIDUAL 1024×1024. Un solo muro centrado en canvas transparente. Strictly top-down 90°. Tight bbox crop → resize 128×32.

frames.prompt: A single top-down cartoon sci-fi wall barrier sprite, centered on a fully transparent background. Camera is STRAIGHT DOWN at 90 degrees — only the TOP FACE is visible, NO side face, NO front face, NO 3D perspective. The wall is a wide flat horizontal rectangle (approx 4:1 width-to-height ratio). INTACT state — no damage. Dark armored steel surface (#2A2A3A) with subtle brushed metal highlight band across the center. Bold geometric panel lines / rivets running along the long edges. A vivid BRIGHT GREEN energy stripe (#00FF66) glows along the entire bottom long edge — sharp neon glow with green bloom radiating upward across the metal surface, giving it a cool green tinted sheen. Two small glowing green LED dots near each end. Clean, sharp, pristine. Bold dark charcoal outline. Soft drop shadow below. Transparent background, nothing else.
frames.negative_prompt: side view, front face, isometric, any 3D perspective, angled view, realistic, photorealistic, pixel art, stone, sandy, beige, earthy, cracked, damaged, text, watermark, background scenery

phaser_config.notes: Stripe verde = HP completo. wall-v-hp3 = mismo PNG rotado 90° por código.
